trace.question: How many patients have a normal level of anti-ribonuclear protein and have been admitted to the hospital?
trace.evidence: normal level of anti-ribonuclear protein refers to RNP = '-', '+-'; And'-' means 'negative'; '+-' refers to '0'; admitted to the hospital refers to Admission = '+'; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;

attempts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.RNP IN ('-', '+-', '0')
  AND p.Admission = '+'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.RNP IN ('-', '+-', '0')
  AND p.Admission = '+'
trace.answer: There are 29 patients with a normal anti-ribonuclear protein level who have been admitted to the hospital.
